summary: P1.2 is not formally closed. The three-clean-review standard remains an owner-maintained manual count outside the repo. V53-V56 exposed certified exact persisted-cut replay and master faithful-encoding obligations, now consolidated under the V56 anchor. The repo remains fail-closed until an explicit owner manual decision opens P1.3B.

manual_review_standard.policy_note: Review receipts and reports can help the owner audit a review, but they are not machine authority for clean credit or P1.3B entry. Clean-review counting is an owner decision outside repo-derived automation.

owner_manual_state.note: The repo intentionally does not record or compute 0/3, 1/3, 2/3, or 3/3. The owner keeps the count and will add an explicit owner_manual_decision if P1.3B entry is approved. Current review anchor for subsequent review packages is v56_certified_cut_replay_consolidation.

next_phase_entry.reason: Blocked by default. P1.3B entry requires an explicit owner_manual_decision; review receipts cannot open this gate.

informational_history.summary: External review found real soundness issues; this remains historical evidence, not an automatic counter input.
Step 7 evaluator attachability was consolidated with Step 6 after V29-V31 sibling bypasses.
Runtime-cache and source-digest findings remained algorithmic/proof-obligation risks.
V37-V46 findings showed that repo-derived receipt/report/Git authority was becoming its own attack surface.
V47-V50 closed strict-JSON receipt clean-counter state-machine false-ready paths, motivating removal of automatic repo-derived clean counting.
The repo no longer auto-counts clean reviews or auto-opens P1.3B from receipts. Owner manual decision is the only P1.3B entry authority.

V53-V56 found sibling findings in exact-safe BendersCut replay: strict evidence parsing, strict conflict/condition integer payloads, unresolved conflict member dilution, and aliasing conflict members that could strengthen a multi-member nogood into a one-literal ban.

Certified cut replay faithfulness is now an explicit P1.2 proof obligation. Future reviews should start from this anchor and look for remaining payload-coercion, missing-member, aliasing, condition-resolution, or apply/register atomicity bypasses.

receipt_policy.note: Receipts remain useful for human audit trails, but this gate does not parse receipts to compute clean-review credit.
